attempts.text:
This plan costs 496 minutes. Naukunda shelter is the only designated evacuation point, so every rescue has to end there.

- **Syaphru school (4 children):** its only road, to Dupcheshwar market, is closed, so the car cannot reach them. I defer them for 240.
- **Dupcheshwar market (7 elderly):** the car reaches them via Shivapuri market, an 80-minute round trip. At capacity 4 that takes two trips, 160 in total. Deferring all seven would cost 350, so the two trips are worth it.
- **Gosaikunda care home (3 adults) and Benighat market (4 adults):** two separate trips cost 40 and 56, 96 in total. The alternatives are worse: one combined trip plus deferring three adults costs 116, and deferring all seven adults costs 140.

drive car1 shivapuri-market dupcheshwar-market
